outcome: Discrepancy between gestational age based on last menstrual period and ultrasound
finding: While traditional cigarettes were associated with worse maternal-fetal outcomes compared to heated tobacco products, the authors do not recommend HTP use during pregnancy as outcomes were not comparable to non-smokers.
mod_finding: Women who smoked traditional cigarettes had higher rates of cesarean sections and preterm delivery compared to other groups.
birth_weight: Average newborn weight percentile was lower in the traditional cigarette smoking group.
